name: get_generation
description: List the takes of a 21st AI Sketch or Code generation you own. Pass its `projectId`. Returns each take's `take` number (1-based, matching the 'Take N' labels shown in the preview) and whether its draft has rendered yet (`ready`). FREE, including when AI is off. Use get_take to retrieve an existing draft. Editing with iterate_generation requires that tool to be available in tools/list.

projectId.description: The generation's projectId (structuredContent.projectId from a `generate` result).
